'''R5-232''' was an [[R5 series astromech droid]] with [[Color|white]], black, grey and blue plating and silver [[sensor]]s.<ref name="Hasbro">{{DisneyToyCite|set=Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=R2-F1P · R5-232 · R2-S8 · R5-PHT|altlink=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=JReviews&rop=showcontent&id=3253}}</ref> Like all [[R-series|R5]] [[astromech droid]]s, it was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]] and stood ninety-seven [[centimeter]]s tall.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

In [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events on [[Corellia]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', which includes R5-PHT's appearance, to [[13 BBY]].</ref> the [[droid]] served the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="SWAuthentics" /> and was present in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]] in [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. It was standing close to the front of a queue for one of the [[spaceport]]'s customs gates while the [[scrumrat]]s [[Han Solo|Han]] and [[Qi'ra]] bribed [[Imperial Emigration Officer|emigration officer]]<ref name="Solo" /> [[Falthina Sharest]]<ref name="SoloOG">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> in the next queue over.<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-232 was created for the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology film]], ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The droid was first revealed prior to the film's release as part of a [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] toy set produced by [[Hasbro]] earlier in 2018.<ref name="RS-news">{{Rebelscum|url=story/front/New_Disney_Parks_Droid_Factory_Astromech_Set_Is_Out_180403.asp|text=New Disney Parks Droid Factory Astromech Set Is Out|author=David Martin|date=2018-04-04}}</ref>
